Comment “save” and I’ll email you this Trader Joe’s meal plan one-pager! it’s so easy. and free. I’ll drop a link in my bio too!

Might need to make a few more of these cause I loved this one 🤓 and bonus is if you make this plan again in 1-2 weeks the cost will be significantly less because you’ll have all your basics already!

This plan works for other grocery stores too - you might just have to sub some of the premade sauces, etc. 

#mealplan #traderjoes".

1,927 likes, 2,504 comments - pinchofyum on October 15, 2026: "New fall set! 🍂 I just had a conversation with a friend who did a big set of (different) freezer meals, and she was discouraged because the meals didn’t taste that good. I am so confident that these are a different thing than just “dump it all in the crockpot and hope for the best.” I’ve tested these all *multiple* times as freezer meals and LOVE THEM ALL. 

✔️ top rated recipes from my website 
✔️ whole food ingredients 
✔️ family friendly 
✔️ prep done in ONE HOUR 

This is the best feeling I give myself every month! Preparedness with good food is such a good feeling!! 

Comment “save” for the link to all these recipes / free labels! ❤️❤️".

11K likes, 7,463 comments - pinchofyum on October 7, 2026: "Rating the meals I made for my family, as a mom who loves fun food but also wants recipes that are at least a lil bit family friendly! 🙂

I’ve relied heavily on those fall freezer meals lately - several of these ones (muffins, meatballs) were ALREADY MADE IN THE FREEZER, best feeling ever. 

Comment “save” and I’ll send you all these recipes!

WEEKLY AWARDS

🏅 My favorite: crispy chicken w creamy beans

🏅 Kids’ favorites (there were many!!): ricotta meatballs, apple crisp, pumpkin muffins 

🏅 Husband’s favorites: chicken with cajun sauce, apple crisp

Have a great week! ❤️".

15K likes, 8,321 comments - pinchofyum on September 19, 2026: "I had to hold myself back from literally drinking that broth from a little bowl. 🤤 A quick simmer, and an air fry for some chicken or tofu, and you’re good to go! 

Comment “save” and I’ll send you this recipe ❤️ or you can find it on my website! 

Ft. lemongrass, shallots, lime, coconut which are traditional Southeast Asian flavors and I think truly some of the best in the world.".
